title: Cycloaddition and functionalization reactions involving tropone
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,34282-34299
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05481H, Review Article

Fatemeh Doraghi, Mohammad Hadi Edareh, Bagher Larijani, Mohammad Mahdavi
Tropones and its derivatives are highly valuable and readily available seven-membered ring compounds that undergo both cycloaddition and functionalization reactions, yielding diverse products. This review highlights these reactions.
